title: .devhelp.yml
description: Project-specific setup recipe. Committed at the repo root as .devhelp.yml or .devhelp.yaml, or shipped under recipes/<owner>__<repo>.yml in the devhelp registry. Parser is intentionally a small YAML subset: scalars + string lists at the top level only.

dev.description: Command to start the dev server (e.g. 'pnpm dev'). Overrides what detection inferred.

test.description: Command to run the test suite (e.g. 'pnpm test'). Overrides what detection inferred.

build.description: Command to produce a production build (e.g. 'pnpm build'). Overrides what detection inferred.

postInstall.description: Setup steps that run after install/env/codegen, in order. Each runs with the same trust as the repo's own install scripts — keep steps minimal and verifiable (a seed script, a codegen command).

notes.description: Free-text reminders surfaced in the final panel. These never execute, so they're safe to add freely — use them for caveats no detector can infer (e.g. 'Postgres must be running first: docker compose up -d db').
